meanings: something rare and precious; the finest of its kind

examples.en: This poem is the pearl of the whole collection.
A kind word is a pearl that cannot be bought.

meanings: a vast expanse; a person of boundless knowledge or generosity

examples.ar: أنا البحر في أحشائه الدر كامن
examples.en: I am the sea; in its depths the pearls lie hidden.
examples.source: Hafez Ibrahim, speaking as the Arabic language

examples.en: The sea has a sound like breathing.
The divers plunge in search of pearls.
Her words were like scattered pearls.
The little girl gathered shells on the shore.
A wooden box inlaid with mother-of-pearl.
The coral reefs glimmer beneath the water.
The waves broke upon the rocks.
The crowd surged through the square like waves.

examples.ar: الغوص في الكتب متعة لا تنتهي.
examples.en: Diving into books is a pleasure without end.
Did they ever ask the diver about my shells?
In the depth of the sea there is a strange stillness.
The depth of his thinking astonished me.
We walked along the shore until sunset.

meanings: a place of rest after a journey

examples.en: Every ship has a harbor to return to.

examples.ar: رفع البحّار الشراع مع أول نسمة.
examples.en: The sailor raised the sail with the first breath of wind.

meanings: (qindīl al-baḥr) jellyfish — literally “lamp of the sea”

examples.ar: رأينا قنديل البحر يطفو قرب الشاطئ.
examples.en: We saw a jellyfish — a “sea lamp” — drifting near the shore.
He hung a lamp above the door.
Light came in through the window.
His face overflowed with light.
The moon’s radiance filled the valley.

meanings: the red glow of twilight after sunset

examples.en: The sky reddened with the color of twilight.

meanings: dusk; the first darkness of night

examples.en: The shepherds came home at dusk.
The city woke to the light of dawn.
That was the dawn of a new era.

meanings: the last hour of night, just before dawn

examples.ar: أجمل الأحاديث ما كان في السحر.
examples.en: The loveliest conversations are the ones held just before dawn.

meanings: the bright late morning, when the sun is well risen

examples.en: We sat in the garden in the bright late morning.
The crescent appeared, slender, above the palms.

examples.ar: كان وجهها كالبدر في ليلة تمامه.
examples.en: Her face was like the moon on the night it is full.
The travelers found their way by the stars.
The Pleiades glitter in the winter sky.

examples.ar: تدلت ثريا من الكريستال فوق المائدة.
examples.en: A crystal chandelier hung above the table.
We live in the Milky Way — in Arabic, “the path of the straw-sellers.”
The sky cleared after the rain.
The horses, the night and the desert all know me.
Night is a veil and a stillness.

meanings: a tender yearning for someone or somewhere

examples.en: I am filled with longing for my grandfather’s house.
The reed flute’s longing for the reed bed.

meanings: yearning; the ache to see someone again

examples.en: She wrote him a letter overflowing with yearning.

meanings: wistful sorrow; a sad, sweet ache

examples.en: There is an old sorrow in the singer’s voice.

meanings: overwhelming emotion; ecstatic love or grief

examples.en: He wept from the sheer force of feeling.

examples.ar: عاش الشاعر في هيام لا ينتهي.
examples.en: The poet lived in an infatuation that never ended.
He confided his ardent longing to his friend.
Among the poets, passionate love has many degrees.
Her mother wrapped her in tenderness.

meanings: warm companionship; the comfort of company

examples.ar: وجدت في الكتاب أنسًا في وحدتي.
examples.en: In the book I found company for my solitude.

examples.ar: حلّت السكينة على البيت بعد العاصفة.
examples.en: Calm settled over the house after the storm.

examples.ar: شعرت بالطمأنينة حين سمعت صوت أمي.
examples.en: I felt at peace the moment I heard my mother’s voice.

meanings: desolation; the loneliness left by absence

examples.en: Life abroad left a desolation in his heart.

meanings: exile; the state of being far from home

examples.en: His years away from home stretched to twenty.

meanings: musical rapture; ecstasy brought on by music

examples.en: The audience swayed in rapture.

examples.ar: عمّت البهجة أرجاء الحي في العيد.
examples.en: Joy spread through the whole neighborhood on Eid.
He welcomed us with gladness and a smile.
Happiness lives in small things.
Contentment is a treasure that never runs out.
There is still hope in the heart.

examples.ar: تحقق حلمها بعد سنوات من العمل.
examples.en: Her dream came true after years of work.
The imagination is wider than the world.

meanings: a fleeting apparition, especially of a beloved in a dream

examples.en: Your image came to me in my sleep.

examples.ar: يتحلل الضوء إلى طيف من الألوان.
examples.en: Light breaks apart into a spectrum of colors.

meanings: an illusion that recedes as you approach

examples.en: The water in the desert was only a mirage.
The echo of his voice rang through the valley.
The book found a wide echo among readers.
We rested in the shade of a tree.
There is a great deal said in silence.
I heard the leaves whispering in the wind.
Patience is the key to relief.
Loyalty is among a friend’s finest qualities.
Hatim al-Tai was legendary for his generosity.

meanings: decency and honor; the virtue of doing right by others

examples.en: It is part of honor to help the weak.
He acted with real gallantry when he saved the child.
Nations are built on high resolve.

meanings: insight; the sight of the heart

examples.ar: كان أعمى البصر لكنه نافذ البصيرة.
examples.en: He was blind in his eyes but piercing in his insight.
I learned wisdom from my grandmother.

examples.ar: قفا نبك من ذكرى حبيب ومنزل
examples.en: Halt, my two friends, let us weep at the memory of a beloved and a dwelling.
That night remained a beautiful memory.

examples.ar: قضى المساء في التأمل أمام البحر.
examples.en: He spent the evening in contemplation before the sea.
Music leaves its mark on the soul.

examples.ar: ما يخرج من القلب يدخل إلى القلب.
examples.en: What comes from the heart reaches the heart.
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
Essence matters more than appearance.
The crown was set with red rubies.
The fields were as green as emerald.
A friend is his friend’s mirror.
Rain has a scent the earth loves.

meanings: rain that ends a drought; relief-bringing rain

examples.en: The farmers rejoiced at the rain that broke the drought.
A soft, steady rain fell all through the night.
Dew glistened on the rose petals.
A gentle breeze blew in from the sea.

meanings: the east wind — the soft morning breeze beloved of poets

examples.en: The east wind carried the scent of the flowers.
The hurricane destroyed the coastal villages.
The clouds passed over the mountain.
Fog blanketed the city in the morning.
Lightning lit the sky for a single moment.
We heard thunder in the distance.
A rainbow appeared after the rain.

examples.ar: وصلت القافلة إلى الواحة عند المساء.
examples.en: The caravan reached the oasis at nightfall.
The silence of the desert at night is awe-inspiring.
We climbed the dune to watch the sunset.
The caravan traveled the Silk Road.
The Bedouin pitched their tents near the well.

meanings: the traces of an abandoned encampment — the ruins where classical poems begin

examples.en: The poet stood weeping over the ruins.
The gazelle ran lightly among the dunes.
The falcon soared high above the desert.

examples.ar: غنى العندليب في الحديقة حتى الفجر.
examples.en: The nightingale sang in the garden until dawn.
The dove built her nest on the balcony.
The butterfly flew toward the light.
The date palm is a symbol of generosity and patience.
The olive tree lived for hundreds of years.

examples.ar: تفوح رائحة الياسمين في أزقة دمشق.
examples.en: The scent of jasmine drifts through the alleys of Damascus.
The narcissus opened at the very start of spring.
I gave her a bouquet of red roses.
Every flower has its season.
The branch bowed under the weight of its fruit.

examples.ar: شربنا من نبع صافٍ في الجبل.
examples.en: We drank from a clear mountain spring.
The brook runs between the fields.
My grandfather planted an orange orchard.

examples.ar: كانت الأندلس فردوسًا مفقودًا في شعرهم.
examples.en: In their poetry, al-Andalus was a paradise lost.

examples.ar: بقي عطره في الغرفة بعد رحيله.
examples.en: His perfume lingered in the room after he had gone.
The fragrance of flowers fills the garden.
The evening ended on musk — a perfect finish.

examples.ar: يُستخرج العنبر من البحر ويُصنع منه العطر.
examples.en: Ambergris is gathered from the sea and made into perfume.
The house filled with the scent of incense.
Children carry lanterns through the streets in Ramadan.
The pen cuts deeper than the sword.
The ink dried, but the story did not end.

examples.ar: لكل حرف في العربية شكل وروح.
examples.en: Every letter in Arabic has a shape and a soul.
Many a single word has changed a life.
A language is a homeland we carry with us.

meanings: Arabic itself — “the language of the ḍād”

examples.en: Arabic is called the language of the ḍād, a sound thought unique to it.
Al-Jahiz was famed for his eloquence.
He spoke with a clarity that astonished everyone present.
Truly, some eloquence is a kind of magic.

examples.ar: الخط العربي فن يجمع الصبر والجمال.
examples.en: Arabic calligraphy is an art that unites patience and beauty.
The poet recited an ode to the homeland.
The poet chose a difficult rhyme.
I read al-Mutanabbi’s collected poems from cover to cover.

examples.ar: كانت جدتي تروي لنا حكاية كل ليلة.
examples.en: My grandmother told us a tale every night.

meanings: night conversation; talking late under the moon

examples.en: The late-night talk was sweet beneath the moonlight.

meanings: boon companion; a friend for long evenings

examples.ar: كان الكتاب نديمه في الليالي الطويلة.
examples.en: The book was his companion through the long nights.
Choose the companion before the road.

examples.ar: لكل إنسان خليل يبوح له بسره.
examples.en: Everyone has a close friend to whom they confide their secret.
We are only passing through this world.
Ibn Battuta was a celebrated traveler.
Honor your guest, even if you are poor.

meanings: an age, a long span of time

examples.en: The city changed over the ages.
I will remember this day forever.

meanings: eternity without beginning; time before time

examples.ar: تتحدث الأساطير عن نور وُجد منذ الأزل.
examples.en: The legends tell of a light that has existed since before time began.

meanings: a brief while, a short moment

examples.en: He was silent for a moment, then smiled.
Live the moment as if it will never return.
A fountain sits at the heart of the Damascene courtyard.
The golden dome gleams beneath the sun.
Light slips in through the carved lattice of the mashrabiya.
He played a sorrowful melody on the oud.
The house was perfumed with smoking agarwood.
